notes.title: "Trapped In The Omniverse" coming in 2026. Thanks for wishlisting!
notes.content: [h3][b]Hello everyone![/b] [/h3][p]We want to sincerely thank those who have already added "Trapped In The Omniverse" to their wishlist. The game is coming in April 2026 and we are working hard to make it an unforgettable experience. If you haven’t yet, we invite you to join the wishlist and share it with your friends. Your support means everything to us! We will share more news and details soon.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45293150/8a688c4bdb6e24caa54b3476d4f0328f700982aa.jpg"][/img][/p][previewyoutube="sFDgGI8QLco;full"][/previewyoutube]
